sources.fullCitation: Library of Congress name authority record for the pseudonymous identity Marylis, Guy, 1880-1944 (LCCN n2017060192). The VIAF cluster that gathers it, VIAF 221170232, also carries the Bibliothèque nationale de France heading Bonnal, Ermend, 1880-1944, compositeur (ark:/12148/cb16557102j), with a see-also reference between the two names, which is the evidence that Guy Marylis is a name of Joseph-Ermend Bonnal. Accessed 6 August 2026.
